model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна, показваща точността (%) на различни модели или подходи в три категории: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. По хоризонталната ос са представени трите категории, а по вертикалната ос – точността в проценти, с диапазон от 50 до 62 със стъпка 2. Всяка категория има група от пет стълба, всяка от които представлява различен модел или комбинация от модели, като цветовете и текстурите на стълбовете съответстват на легендата: DAPO+Self-reflection (син с вертикални линии), GRPO (оранжев с наклонени линии), DAPO (сив с диагонални линии), SRPO (оранжев без текстура), PPO+Self-reflection (зелен с хоризонтални линии) и PPO (зелен с кръстосани линии). Стълбовете във всяка група са подредени във визуално съвпадащ ред, като всеки стълб представлява отделна категория. Всички стълбове са визуализирани със съответната текстура или цвят, без допълнителни визуални акценти като засенчване или удебеляване. В категорията Physics стълбовете са най-високи, като стълбът за DAPO+Self-reflection достига около 61%, докато най-ниският стълб, за DAPO в категорията Mathverse, е около 53%.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart displays the accuracy percentages of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain, with the three categories listed from left to right in that order. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major tick marks at intervals of 2 percentage points. Each domain on the horizontal axis contains a group of five bars, each representing one of the models, with their respective labels and patterns indicated in the legend. The bars are color-coded and patterned as follows: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (light green with diagonal stripes). For the Mathverse domain, the accuracy values are approximately 53% for DAPO, 56% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 53.5% for GRPO, 53.5% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 56% for PPO. In the MMLU domain, the values are approximately 56% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56% for DAPO, 55.5% for GRPO, 54.5% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 57% for PPO. For the Physics domain, the accuracy values are approximately 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 57.5% for DAPO, 58.5% for GRPO, 57% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 59% for PPO. The bars within each group are arranged side-by-side, and the chart shows a general trend of higher accuracy in the Physics domain compared to the other two domains. The chart does not appear to be sorted by any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors and patterns.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major gridlines at 50, 52, 54, 56, 58, and 60. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, five bars are shown, each representing one of the models and distinguished by a unique color and pattern: blue with vertical lines for DAPO+Self-reflection, orange with diagonal lines for GRPO, light blue with diagonal lines for DAPO, green with diagonal lines for PPO+Self-reflection, and green with horizontal lines for PPO. In the Mathverse domain, the accuracy values are approximately 53% for DAPO, 53.5% for GRPO, 55.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 53.5% for SRPO, and 54.5% for PPO+Self-reflection. In the MMLU domain, the values are approximately 55.5% for DAPO, 55.5% for GRPO, 57% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 54.5% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 57% for SRPO. In the Physics domain, the values are approximately 57.5% for DAPO, 58% for GRPO, 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 57% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 60.5% for SRPO. The chart clearly shows that DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy in the Physics domain, while SRPO achieves the highest accuracy in the MMLU domain.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit (in Prozent) verschiedener Modelle auf drei verschiedenen Datensätzen: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics, wobei die Genauigkeit auf der vertikalen Achse dargestellt ist und die Datensätze auf der horizontalen Achse angeordnet sind. Die vertikale Achse ist in einem linearen Skalierungsbereich von 50 bis 62 Prozent mit Beschriftungen in Schritten von 2 Prozent angegeben. Die horizontale Achse listet die drei Datensätze in alphabetischer Reihenfolge auf. Für jeden Datensatz sind fünf gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die jeweils einem Modell entsprechen: DAPO+Self-reflection (blauer Balken mit diagonalen blauen Linien), GRPO (orange Balken mit diagonalen orangefarbenen Linien), DAPO (grauer Balken mit diagonalen grauen Linien), SRPO (oranger Balken mit diagonalen orangefarbenen Linien) und PPO+Self-reflection (grüner Balken mit diagonalen grünen Linien). Die Balken sind in Gruppen nach Datensatz angeordnet, wobei die Gruppen von links nach rechts in der Reihenfolge Mathverse, MMLU und Physics angeordnet sind. Die Legende befindet sich oben rechts und ordnet jeder Modellbezeichnung eine Farbe und ein Muster zu. Die Balkenlängen variieren innerhalb und zwischen den Gruppen, wobei beispielsweise der Balken für DAPO+Self-reflection im Physics-Datensatz die höchste Genauigkeit aufweist, während der Balken für DAPO im Mathverse-Datensatz die niedrigste Genauigkeit innerhalb dieser Gruppe darstellt. Es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck, und die Balken sind nicht nach einer bestimmten Größe sortiert, sondern nach den Datensätzen gruppiert.
